card.name: Words just before an exclamation mark
card.fires_on: Words in informal or quoted web text where an exclamation mark is likely to come next, such as the end of a thank-you, a slogan, a cheer, or an exclaimed quote.

modes.label: Thanks and cheerful closers
modes.description: Last word of a friendly sign-off where an exclamation mark would follow.

modes.label: Shouted slogans
modes.description: Words inside quoted chants or protest slogans that end in an exclamation.
modes.example: They also shouted, "Away with the National Conference without<< Women>>!"

modes.label: Upbeat invitations
modes.description: Words in cheerful encouragements or titles where an exclamation mark is expected.

card.plain: It fires on words right before a place where an exclamation mark would normally come, like a thank-you or a slogan.
